generation_fact: One generation_fact is one atomic relation established by an execution: the exact source information, realized transformation, concrete occurrence, formed outcome, and relation role.
generation_occurrence: A generation_occurrence identifies one concrete execution; it can establish several generation facts, but occurrence identity and the identities of its facts and results remain distinct.
atomic_generation_fact: An atomic generation fact retains its own exact (source, transformation, occurrence, outcome; role) tuple and must be queried and validated as that indivisible relation.
realizes_fact: realizes_fact is the primitive link from a concrete occurrence to each exact generation fact that the occurrence established.
reads_from: reads_from records an actual data dependency and must be followed when establishing how an occurrence or outcome used prior information.
GeneratedOrigin: GeneratedOrigin permits an outcome formed by an earlier fact to participate with that exact identity as a source in a later fact.
program_order: program_order records declared execution order only; by itself it establishes neither a data dependency nor concurrency, and derived claims must name their primitive traversal rule.
equal_values: Equal numeric values or equal outputs do not identify equal facts, occurrences, results, or formation histories; value similarity cannot replace exact graph identity.
cartesian_recombination: Facts realized by one occurrence must not be decomposed into source and result sets and recombined by Cartesian product, because that invents relations the occurrence did not establish.
missing_relations: A missing relation means only that it was not established in the graph; it does not automatically prove the relation false, and absence of a concurrency edge does not prove concurrency.
forward_query: A forward training query preserves exact identities along training sample -> batch occurrence -> forward occurrence -> loss -> backward occurrence -> gradient -> optimizer occurrence -> new parameter version, using validated primitive facts and actual dependencies rather than timestamps or values.
reverse_query: A reverse query begins at the exact evaluation or parameter result and follows its actual incidence, realizes_fact, GeneratedOrigin, and reads_from relations backward; timestamp proximity and numeric similarity are not substitutes.
executable_claim: The sealed executable mechanism is the scientific authority: it must update from allowed prefix state without reading the future, while the report only explains and cites that executable claim; every causally important variable must execute or have a supported elimination test.
state_sufficiency: Test closure by comparing equal or sufficiently similar proposed (q, a) cases: materially incompatible (q_next, y_next), a separating omitted graph variable, continued evolution under a held visible state, or an unproducible transition falsifies the state and requires revision or enlargement.
prefix_only_falsification: Before sealing, replay multiple historical cuts before, near, and after candidate transitions: expose only each prefix, initialize from it, forecast an unread suffix, compare prospectively, retain failures, and revise or reject rather than relying on a full-run fit.
report_code_correspondence: Map every forecast-relevant report claim to exact primitive GFG evidence, an executable state field or justified elimination, and the precise update-law expression; every field must have an update or be a frozen constant derived only from the allowed prefix.
operational_state_use: Field presence is not operational use: for each claimed controlling field identify the expression through which it can change a required prediction, then perturb, remove, or hold it fixed in prefix-only replay; a field with no forecast effect must be diagnostic or the law must be revised.
intervention_state_audit: For an intervention, enumerate all mechanism state read or written by the affected operation, identify what the hook changes, freezes, and leaves evolving, propagate every difference through the law, and test eligible prefixes; holding one visible quantity does not freeze internal state or justify pure time translation.
cross_run_invariance: Separate fixed structural laws, prefix-inferred state, discovery-estimated parameters, and uncertainty; falsify clock, period, amplitude, rate, and fixed-increment regularities at multiple prefix cuts, and treat matched compressed-state/input cases with divergent futures as insufficiency requiring more state or context. Passing within-run replay is only non-falsification; transport requires the sealed model to succeed prospectively on a distinct unseen continuous execution.
